chapter: Three D's and Bay Area struggles
title: Teaching piano students; Earle Weatherwax
summary: He taught some students and remains in touch with nightclub singer-pianist Earle Weatherwax.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories

blocks.x: After drug dealers and everything else, you had jazz. Did you ever take piano students during this period? Did you ever teach piano?
How did you approach that? Was that something that you found satisfying, or frustrating?
It was interesting. It’s all right. I am still in touch with one of my students. Do you think Earle would . . .?

Do you think Earle would mind being . . . Earle Weatherwax is his name. He went on to be an entertainer in nightclubs as singer and pianist. We see him quite frequently. Chris see him, and Danny sees him a lot.
Where does he live? Do you know, Russell?
He lives in Arizona most of the time.
